title: Add a category of work to a company or partnership contractor licence
summary: You can request to add additional categories of work to your company or partnership contractor licence if you become eligible for new types of work.
intro:
If you hold a company or partnership contractor licence and become eligible to work in additional categories of work – for example, you've taken on a supervisor with additional qualifications – you can request to add a category(s) to the licence.

You can make your request:
who_can_apply: Hold a company or partnership contractor licence.
Become eligible to work in additional categories of work (e.g., taking on a supervisor with additional qualifications).
Have a current Australian identity document (such as a driver licence, passport, Medicare card) to verify identity.
Provide the company or partnership's ACN or ABN.
Ensure your current email address and mobile phone number are registered with Fair Trading.
what_you_need: For online application: MyServiceNSW Account, current Australian identity document, company/partnership ACN or ABN, and registered email/mobile number.
For in-person application: The 'Company or Partnership Application' form.

how_to_steps.text: Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
Enter the required information on the application form.
Follow the prompts to add the additional category(s).
Download, print and complete the Application Form – Company or Partnership – PDF
Visit a service centre and submit your application in person.

more_info.text: You need a medical gas licence to do any medical gas work in NSW, regardless of the work cost or whether it's residential, commercial or industrial.

faqs.q: How can I add a category of work to my licence?
faqs.a: You can apply online by logging into your MyServiceNSW Account, entering the required information, and following the prompts to add the additional category(s). Alternatively, you can visit a service centre and submit your application in person.

faqs.q: What do I need to apply online?
faqs.a: You must have a MyServiceNSW Account, a current Australian identity document, the company or partnership's ACN or ABN, and your current email address and mobile phone number must be registered with Fair Trading.

faqs.q: What do I need if I visit a service centre?
faqs.a: You will need the 'Company or Partnership Application' form.
